<div class="card-body">
'''Leia's Back''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">レイアの帰還</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらか選ぶ。1：レイアがロストした時に使う。1フォース消費して、ロストデッキから抜き、再使用する。2：3フォース消費して、リザーブデッキを探してレイアを手札に入れる。デッキをシャッフルして、カットすること。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-94o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「本当の戦いはこれからよ！」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Leia's return.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. If Leia is lost, use 1 Force to retrieve her from the Lost Pile. Use 3 Force to search your Reserve Deck and take Leia into hand. Shuffle and cut the deck.

'''Lore:''' “The real fight starts now!”
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Leia's Back]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
